QuestInfo.name: Making Peace
QuestInfo.0: Tatamo decided that the Halflingers weren't suited for war.
QuestInfo.1: Tatamo decides that war is not for Halflingers and offers that peace will be found through conversation. Go go get #bRex the Hoblin King's#k signature on the #r#t4033789##k as Tatamo has requested.
QuestInfo.2: You have tricked Rex the Hoblin King into signing the peace agreement. The method wasn't too honorable but it will be keeping the peace in Leafre.

0.0: I've decided! No war! We're not built for it. So now I want to work out a peace treaty with our enemies.
0.1: I want to start with the Hoblins in Minar Forest. Will you be our ambassador?

yes.0: The Hoblins live in #b#MDmirrorD_321_0_##k. Go meet #bRex the Hoblin King#k there. #rDo whatever you have to do#k to get him to sign this Peace Treaty.

no.0: What, you want an old man like me to go? Why don't you young people respect the elderly these days?

yes.0: R-really? Rex agreed to the Peace Treaty? You're a true hero for Leafre! A true hero!

default.0: Don't worry! If things don't work out, I'll take care of your funeral costs. Just get #rRex's#k signature. #rRex#k resides in #b#MDmirrorD_321_0_##k.
